title: Gold Master
tagline: The tape is due and the office runs on tea!
blurb: The tape is due and the office runs on tea! As Mo the producer, carry the work from desk to desk, keep the coders' mugs full, squash the bugs and shoo Percy the cat, then hand the finished Gold Master to Omnibot before his clock runs out. Four games, seven rooms, three floors, and a teacup setting for those who'd rather not rush.

demo.contains: Level 1 of 4: the Production room, from the Design Doc to the Gold Master.

review.verdict: A friendly office juggle that's fair to a fault, let down by a little clash and a short shelf life. Not quite gold, but a shiny silver.

credits.name: Kev Mallin, Ruth Ashdown and Stan Thorley for INK & PAPER
